title: UserHoverCard
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box with MonarchLink as the anchor and MonarchPopover (a Material 3 popup surface) holding MonarchAvatar, MonarchText, MonarchSkeleton while loading, and MonarchButton
summary: A recipe, not a component: tapping a person's name opens a small profile preview with their photo, name, handle, role, status and actions.
whenToUse: Where people's names appear in content (assignees, comments, mentions) and a quick look at who they are saves opening the profile.
whenNotToUse: Not for the full profile (open a profile screen). Not for your own status (use MonarchMyStatus).
api: MonarchLink(text = name, onClick = { open = true }, actionLabel = "show profile preview")
MonarchPopover(expanded = open, onDismissRequest = { open = false }, label = "Profile of …") { … }
MonarchAvatar(image = photo, name = name, size = MonarchAvatarSize.Lg, status = presence, seed = userId)

options.name: open
options.description: Whether the preview is shown; set by the link and cleared by onDismissRequest or an action.

options.name: loading
options.description: True while the app fetches details that are not in the list already; those lines show as a skeleton.

states.name: closed
states.description: The name in the inline link style.

states.name: open
states.description: A popover with the avatar and presence, the name, handle and role, the status and local time, and Message and View profile.

states.name: loading
states.description: The details are a text skeleton read as "Loading profile"; the name and avatar, already known, show at once.

appearance: The popover takes the raised surface with its shadow; the avatar uses its presence dot; the name is in the subheading style and the details in the muted caption style; actions are a small secondary and a small ghost button.
platformNotes: The web's UserHoverCard opens when a pointer rests on a name or when it gets keyboard focus. Touch has no hover, so on Android a tap on the name opens the preview, as on iOS. MonarchPopover keeps it anchored to the name on a phone instead of turning it into a sheet. For a whole row, a long press with a menu is the Android pattern instead. The app owns the profile data and its loading; there is no Monarch type.
accessibility: The name is a link whose TalkBack action is read as "show profile preview", with a 48dp touch target.
The popover is named "Profile of Priya Raman" and the name inside it has the heading role.
The presence is part of the avatar's spoken name, so it does not depend on the dot's color.
While loading, the skeleton is read as "Loading profile".
Message and View profile are buttons with 48dp touch targets; the popover closes on Back or a tap outside.
edgeCases: A long name or role wraps inside the popover, which keeps its maximum width.
With no picture, the avatar shows initials on a color picked from the seed.
